name: Cheese Enchiladas Sauce
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Fry tortillas in hot oil for 5 seconds on each side. Dip tortillas in enchilada sauce; spoon some of the Cheese Sauce inside each and roll up. Place seam side down in a baking dish. Combine remaining Cheese Sauce and enchilada sauce; pour over tortillas. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. To make sauce, melt butter; blend in flour, salt and paprika. Add milk and stir until sauce thickens. Blend in cheese.
